title: Bench Staging Rates on Re-Issued Infrastructure Quotes for Network-Managed Clients
content:
**Staging rate.** The bench staging charge per unit of a re-issued infrastructure quote, a re-issued Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that lapsed unsigned, is **95.00 USD** when the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement covers firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes and the client holds an in-progress Professional Services Projects engagement, **120.00 USD** when it holds such an active ClearPath agreement and no in-progress project engagement, and the order type's staging fee per unit for every other client: 145.00 USD on a Network Equipment Order, 395.00 USD on a Server & Storage Build Order.

Coverage of firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes is read from the coverage of the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active; an in-progress engagement is a project engagement of any class whose status is in progress.

| Active ClearPath agreement covering firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes | In-progress project engagement | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 95.00 | 95.00 |
| Yes | No | 120.00 | 120.00 |
| No (no such coverage, or no active agreement) | Yes | 145.00 | 395.00 |
| No | No | 145.00 | 395.00 |

### Illustration (hypothetical re-issue of 4 units)

The bench staging comes to 380.00 at 95.00, 480.00 at 120.00 and 580.00 at 145.00.
